extraction.Name: Nora Tway Sandery
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee, but took it on the advise of the Superintendent of the Pine Ridge reservation he having told her that if she did not take the patent and pay the taxes that the land would be sold to satisfy them
extraction.Recorded patent: she did not have her patent recorded and that she does not think it has been
extraction.Buyer: a man whose name she does not know, for $2550.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: compelled to sell it for she could not pay the taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: husband is a clerk in a grocery store and they depend on that for a living
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in fair health; has no home and has to rent a home; has four small children depending on her for support, none of them having been allotted; document reference number 76999; subscribed and sworn November 9, 1928, Shannon County, South Dakota
